login.kennitalaHint: 10 digits, with or without a hyphen
login.codeHint: The 6-digit code you received by email

newCode.intro: Enter your kennitala. If it belongs to an active account, a new code will be sent to the email address on file, and the old code will stop working.
newCode.sent: If the kennitala belongs to an active account, a new code will be sent to the email address on file. Each kennitala can get one new code every 10 minutes.

teachers.name: Name
teachers.createHelp: The teacher receives a code by email to log in with.

teachers.codeQueued: A new code will be sent to {email}.

errors.name: Enter a name
errors.kennitalaTaken: This kennitala already has an account
errors.self: You cannot deactivate your own account or remove your own admin rights.

settings.timesHelp: Times are Icelandic time. Leave both fields empty for no time.

errors.dateTime: Enter a valid date and time

codes.warning: Every active student receives a new code by email. Each student's previous code stops working as soon as the new one is sent.
codes.noStudents: No active students. Import the student list first.
codes.started: Codes are being emailed to {count} students. Follow the progress below.

new_code.oldCode: Your old code no longer works. Always use the newest code you have received.

teacher_code.intro: Here is your code for logging in to the Sæludagar website as a teacher:
teacher_code.oldCode: If you had an older code, it no longer works.

student_code.subject: Your Sæludagar code
student_code.intro: On the Sæludagar website you sign up for events during Sæludagar. After attending, you choose a course to have absence points removed. Your code is:

student_code.oldCode: Any older code no longer works.

errors.forbiddenText: You do not have access to this page.
errors.csrfText: Go back to the page, reload it and try again.
errors.notFoundText: The page you were looking for does not exist.
errors.serverText: An error occurred. Please try again later.

import.previewIntro: The file is valid: {count} students. Confirming makes these changes:
import.confirmHelp: Nothing is saved until you confirm. Confirm within 10 minutes.
import.cancelled: The import was cancelled. Nothing was saved.
import.done: Import complete: {added} new, {updated} updated, {deactivated} made inactive and {signupsRemoved} sign-ups removed.
import.errorsIntro: The file was not imported, and nothing was saved. Fix these errors ({count}) and upload the file again:
import.formatHelp: A CSV file with this header line, separated by semicolons (or commas):
import.rowsHelp: One line per student per course. A student with no courses gets one line with an empty course. Active students who are missing from the file become inactive.
import.fileHint: CSV, UTF-8 or Windows-1252 (from Excel), at most 5 MB

errors.unreadable: Line {line}: the file could not be read from here (check the quotation marks)
errors.header: Line {line}: the header must be kennitala;nafn;netfang;braut;afangi
errors.columns: Line {line}: the line must have 5 columns
errors.name: Line {line}: the name is missing or invalid
errors.email: Line {line}: the email address is not valid
errors.mismatch: Line {line}: name, email and braut must be the same as on line {first} for the same student
errors.teacher: Line {line}: this kennitala belongs to a teacher
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large. The limit is 5 MB.
errors.upload: The file could not be received. Try again.
errors.expired: The import has expired or was already confirmed. Upload the file again.
errors.changed: A teacher account now has one of the kennitölur in the file. Nothing was saved. Upload the file again.
